description:
See your Transport Fever 3 world live on your phone or tablet while you play - like a second screen.

What you get:
- Live map: terrain, water, roads and tracks, towns with population, industries with the cargo they accept and produce, all stations and lines along their real routes, vehicles moving.
- Tap anything for details: line load and active cargo, interval, station catchment, industry production.
- Tap a place or a vehicle and the game camera jumps there / follows it.
- Filters by transport type, passengers/cargo, industry types; any map rotation; km or miles; export the network as SVG.
- 13 languages (same as the game).

How it works:
This mod only writes map data to the game's save folder. A small free companion app on the same computer turns it into a web page; open it on any phone or tablet in the same Wi-Fi. Nothing is sent to the internet.

Install:
1. Subscribe to this mod and enable it when you load your save.
2. Download the companion app (Windows .exe, or Mac/Linux script): https://github.com/vrq8tk5mbs-bot/tf3-minimap/releases/latest
3. Start the companion, open the address it shows on your phone.

PC only (Windows, Mac, Linux / Steam Deck). Does NOT work on consoles - the companion app needs a computer next to the game.
Does not change gameplay (cosmetic script mod).

---

RU: Живая карта вашего мира Transport Fever 3 на телефоне или планшете - второй экран во время игры. Рельеф, дороги и пути, города с населением, производства с иконками грузов, все станции и линии по реальным маршрутам, движущийся транспорт. Нажатие - подробности и прыжок камеры игры. Фильтры, поворот карты, км/мили, экспорт схемы в SVG.
Мод пишет данные в папку сохранений игры; бесплатная программа-компаньон на том же компьютере показывает их как веб-страницу для телефона в той же Wi-Fi сети. Только ПК, на консолях не работает.
Компаньон: https://github.com/vrq8tk5mbs-bot/tf3-minimap/releases/latest
name: Minimap Companion
summary: Live map of your game on your phone or tablet: lines, stations, vehicles, industries. Tap to move the camera. PC only.
